label: Phase 2 should be decision-only: record no integration now plus a pre-registered growth gate, and change no runtime file. The restraint rule starts at build nothing and permits a costlier move only when a failure exists today; iteration 6 found no demonstrated Skilled user need and no measured gain for markdown, skill or spec work. The optional pointer fixes no current failure, so it is not phase 2; it is the pre-approved phase 3 move if the gate fires.

The phase 2 file list is the standard Level 2 child shape plus the parent map update; no .skilled file changes. The child carries spec.md, description.json, graph-metadata.json, plan.md, tasks.md, acceptance-criteria.md, implementation-summary.md and a decision-record.md. The decision record is the phase core artifact; a Level 2 packet with one is already precedented in 027-ask-surface-enforcement, though the structure reference lists decision-record.md as Level 3+. The parent needs its Phase Documentation Map and handoff row updated, plus the derived child pointer in its graph-metadata.json.

The one-paragraph pointer is a five-file sk-code hub release, not a one-line edit. The hub version authority ties SKILL.md frontmatter to the newest changelog entry, and the same version sits in description.json, mode-registry.json and hub-router.json. A pointer in SKILL.md section 2 therefore also needs a new changelog/v3.11.5.0.md entry and a version bump in all four files. That is still cheap and reversible, but phase 3 must budget for it and check consistency.

The growth gate should be two falsifiable triggers plus a measurement protocol, not a date or a hunch. Trigger A is an observed failure of the existing search path in a real task: a recorded query where rg/Grep plus the committed trigger index missed a code location that Sweet Search finds, with the repo and both outcomes; two independent occurrences in two repos, or one that blocks an external-repo task, open phase 3. Trigger B is an independent, reproducible benchmark on Skilled-style corpora showing a pre-registered reduction in search tool calls or tokens with no correctness drop; vendor eval data alone does not count. Phase 3 is the conditional pointer; phase 4 (doctor install, Code Mode mirror, or a new mcp-tooling mode) opens only if the pointer demonstrably fails to close the measured gap.

Phase 1 handoff is not met yet: research/research.md is absent. The phase-1 spec requires that synthesis to state a verdict with source tags, and the parent handoff requires a named verdict and one recommended surface before a build phase is planned. Phase 2 entry check must include that file and a passing phase-1 validation.
